desc: Analysed structure: only negative values are deletion candidates; subarrays avoiding removed elements are covered by the Kadane baseline, so only spanning candidates matter.
Implement block-decomposition solution: baseline Kadane + prefix sums + segment tree range max/min over P + per-negative-value block spanning formula; skip values with count==n; handle n==1.
Validate the implemented solution against a brute force on small random arrays and the provided examples/edge cases; report the first mismatch if any.
Discard the broken O(n) prefix-min "W_v" scheme due to counterexample [-1,-1000,50,-1,50].
Timing sanity check at n=1e5 (worst-case many distinct negatives) confirming O(n log n) is acceptable.
